summary: Grasshopper Manufacture and Capcom's cult action-adventure, later preserved through a Windows port.

entries.title: Killer7

emulation.emulator: Native Windows or Dolphin/PCSX2 for original releases
emulation.notes: Use the PC port for play; use Dolphin or PCSX2 only if comparing original console behavior.

primary.why: Killer7 originally released on GameCube and PlayStation 2 in 2005, with a Windows port released in 2018. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most accessible modern route for the cult original.
primary.how_to_play: Play the 2018 Windows version natively; use GameCube or PlayStation 2 emulation only for original-platform preservation.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern PC port with native PC display support.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most accessible route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows port is the modern fidelity route and no sourced platform-exclusive content requires a secondary run.
